summary: The global marketing team is executing a search/AI visibility push for Asia Star and Intelligent China while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving a lingering Outlook lockout.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the search/AI visibility initiative for Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting target prompts and audience profiles from CRM leads, and the team auditing Google Ads conversion tracking (including Berkeley as a possible third priority). The knowledge website redesign is nearing launch: Joseph must share the HTML file and address feedback, followed by a half-hour feedback session with Julie and the team lead, and Joker will implement changes; the design stays largely as-is but incorporates Joseph's editorial layout for inspiration, with videos dispersed by topic and BCI/BSI indices added. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding accounts on all devices, updating the home computer password, re-logging in on the phone, and confirming the backend unlock with CKGSB. Also on the near-term radar: finalize the obituary for Professor Jon Liao, update women's figures across programs with Deng Gang's latest data, and add frame lines to the knowledge page before launch. Upcoming: the Berkeley program audit, completion of the conversion tracking audit, and preparation for the November 24 parking list update and PRME password change.
